_ordering_rationale: Order par PV: AOI Total Segment (top metric), AOI US Businesses (plus gros segment), AOI International (Japan dominant), AOI PGIM (asset mgmt), AUM PGIM (proxy fee revenue).
_note: AOI = Adjusted Operating Income (mesure non-GAAP). Donnees FY21-FY24 retraitees base LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements ASU 2018-12). FY20 non comparable.

kpis.signal: AOI total segments avant Corporate, base LDTI restated
kpis.description_fr: Adjusted Operating Income total segments (PGIM + US + Intl) avant taxes et Corporate. Base LDTI restated. Mesure non-GAAP cle Prudential.
kpis.description_en: Total segment Adjusted Operating Income (PGIM + US + Intl) before tax and Corporate. LDTI restated basis. Key non-GAAP Prudential metric.

kpis.signal: Retirement Strategies dominant (~$3.6Mds FY24), Group Insurance + Individual Life secondaires
kpis.description_fr: AOI US Businesses: Retirement Strategies (annuities + pension risk transfer) + Group Insurance + Individual Life. Retirement Strategies dominant ($3.6Mds FY24).
kpis.description_en: US Businesses AOI: Retirement Strategies (annuities + pension risk transfer) + Group Insurance + Individual Life. Retirement Strategies dominant ($3.6B FY24).

kpis.signal: Japan dominant (Gibraltar Life, POJ), expose JPY/USD, vent contraire FX
kpis.description_fr: AOI International: Japan (Gibraltar Life, Prudential of Japan) dominant + Brazil. Expose JPY/USD, vent contraire FX recent.
kpis.description_en: International AOI: Japan (Gibraltar Life, Prudential of Japan) dominant + Brazil. JPY/USD exposure, recent FX headwind.

kpis.signal: Re-acceleration FY24 +22.7%, marche actions porteur, fixed income leader
kpis.description_fr: AOI PGIM: gestion actifs ($1.5Tn AUM). Fixed income leader, real estate, public equities. Re-acceleration FY24 lie marche actions porteur.
kpis.description_en: PGIM AOI: asset management ($1.5T AUM). Fixed income leader, real estate, public equities. FY24 re-acceleration on strong equity markets.

kpis.signal: Recovery progressive post-choc FY22 (taux), proxy fee revenue PGIM
kpis.description_fr: AUM total Prudential (PGIM + general account + proprietary). Recovery progressive post-choc FY22 (hausse taux). Proxy fee revenue PGIM.
kpis.description_en: Prudential total AUM (PGIM + general account + proprietary). Gradual recovery post FY22 shock (rate hikes). PGIM fee revenue proxy.
